_note: Single source of truth for /resume and the gated full résumé PDF (JSON Resume schema: https://jsonresume.org/schema/, with a deliberate deviation — see below). Per ADR 0007, direct contact info lives under basics.privateContact (email, phone) and is rendered ONLY into the gated full résumé, never on the public /resume page or in its HTML/JSON-LD. The /resume page serves noindex while any value contains the word PLACEHOLDER (see src/lib/resume.ts → resumeHasPlaceholders). Regenerate the PDF with `pnpm resume:pdf` (dev/prod server must be running).

basics.name: Bryan DeBaun
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable cloud-based solutions across healthcare, automotive, and agricultural sectors. Proven track record of migrating legacy systems to modern cloud architectures, leading cross-functional teams, and reducing operational incidents by up to 80%. Expert in the .NET ecosystem, AWS cloud services, and full-stack development, with a strong focus on system reliability, performance optimization, and mentoring junior engineers.

work.name: Cox Automotive
highlights: Scaled the flagship Automated Marketing Platform to handle 300% growth in client base, processing millions of customer messages monthly while maintaining system stability and YoY profit growth through architectural improvements and performance optimization.

Led migration of multiple applications from on-premises to AWS cloud infrastructure, implementing serverless architectures using Lambda, Step Functions, S3, and DynamoDB while upgrading legacy systems from .NET Framework to .NET Core 3.1 and later .NET 6.

Reduced on-call incidents by 80% during high-volume periods by improving system resiliency, establishing comprehensive monitoring with New Relic, and creating detailed runbooks and documentation for on-call personnel.
Pioneered technical solutions including the platform's first Blazor-based front-end UI and an implementation of Kinesis Data Analytics for real-time data processing during payment service migrations.

Mentored junior developers and assumed Tech Lead responsibilities during leadership transitions, establishing code standards using ReSharper across repositories and conducting code reviews for cross-team pull requests.

Managed complex multi-system integrations across the AMP ecosystem (Automated Marketing, CRM, Texting, Reporting, Opportunities, Direct Mail), ensuring seamless communication and data flow between services.

Implemented comprehensive testing strategies including automated unit and integration tests using FluentAssertions (C#) and Chai.js (TypeScript/JavaScript), with BDD test plans using SpecFlow and Cucumber.js.

work.name: NIC
highlights: Developed a multi-tenant prescription monitoring platform processing millions of opioid dispenses monthly across contracted states, helping combat the opioid crisis through real-time clinical alerting for MME thresholds, Multiple Provider Episodes, and Opioid Overlap events.

Architected the transition from a monolithic to a microservices architecture using Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design principles, implementing serverless Azure Functions to improve scalability and maintainability.

Integrated dynamic Power BI reporting and analytics into the core application, collaborating with external contractors to implement embedded reports with dynamic filtering and phased loading for improved user experience.
Managed CI/CD pipelines across two development teams using Azure DevOps, ensuring reliable automated builds, testing, and releases for multiple developers working simultaneously.

Contributed to the migration of prescription drug monitoring data into Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, supporting ETL pipeline development and data normalization to improve data accessibility and analytical readiness.
Collaborated directly with clinicians and medical personnel to design and implement clinical decision support features, translating complex medical requirements into technical solutions.

work.name: The Scoular Company
highlights: Modernized legacy applications for a 25% efficiency improvement by migrating from Access databases to SQL Server and rearchitecting obsolete systems using ASP.NET MVC patterns.

Built a customer-facing settlement portal serving 1,000+ external users, integrating with FileBound document storage to provide secure PDF access through an Azure-hosted ASP.NET Core application with Azure AD authentication.

Developed mobile-first APIs for agricultural business management, creating farmer-facing applications for field operations and trucking logistics using IdentityServer4 and ASP.NET Identity for secure authentication.

Automated the credit application workflow for the Credit department, replacing manual processes with a web application leveraging SQL views to interface with IBM database systems and streamline customer credit review.
Created real-time data APIs interfacing with the CTRM (Commodity Trading and Risk Management) system to enable business-critical decision making.

work.name: K-State IT Helpdesk
highlights: Supported the university-wide email migration from Pegasus to Microsoft Outlook for faculty, staff, and students, providing hands-on technical support and remote troubleshooting.
Provided tier-1 technical support for hardware and software issues, performing computer repairs, restorations, and remote software implementations.

education.note: Left in junior year to accept a full-time software engineering offer.
